title: UN rapporteur says Israeli rubble-clearing in Gaza could erase 'atrocity crimes' evidence
summary: The United Nations special rapporteur on Palestinian territories Francesca Albanese warned Monday that large-scale rubble removal in parts of Gaza under Israeli control could risk erasing "evidence relevant to the investigation of alleged international crimes".
